dedupe_keys.name: eau equipements eau usee grand poitiers donnees metiers

description: Eau - Equipements eau usée - Grand Poitiers Données métiers is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sig.grandpoitiers.fr. The equipment of the wastewater system represents: the nozzles (allow overflow when the grid is overloaded), sanders (tapping the loaded solid particles), weirs (restricting flow), lifting stations (allows the effluent to be raised to the top for gravitary flow). The area covered is that of the 13 municipalities of Grand Poitiers. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Water — Waste water equipment — Grand Poitiers Business data" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Station de relevage, équipements eau usée, deversoir, données ouvertes, dessableur, ajutage. The listing shows 2 download or service links in WMS, WFS. The listing shows 2015-02-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
